programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486302/attempts/db4e56d7e3694d8caea4d8353ff4c479/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):\n    h = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 3 for x in row))\n    w = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == 3 for row in grid))\n    return [[3 if r == h or c == w else (4 if max(abs(r-h), abs(c-w)) % 2 == 0 else 0)\n             for c in range(len(grid[0]))] for r in range(len(grid))]\n'''
path=programs/'task-13fe1ca7.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(path), 'exec'), globals())
